experienceProof.description: Our business, technology and delivery experience enables us to support complex initiatives across platforms, integrations, data, digital solutions and ongoing operations.
experienceProof.case1Title: Unified operations platform for multi-agency service delivery
experienceProof.case1Challenge: Five operational systems, inconsistent data definitions, and manual handoffs made it impossible to track service SLAs end to end.
experienceProof.case1Solution: We designed and delivered a unified operations layer: shared case model, integration bus, realtime dashboards.
experienceProof.case1Role: Estidam led discovery, solution architecture, and program delivery. Technical delivery capacity was extended through our partnership with Inspire for platform engineering and data integration.
experienceProof.case2Title: Unified operations platform for multi-agency service delivery
experienceProof.case2Challenge: Seasonal workforce peaks created fragmented reporting and delayed operational decisions across agencies.
experienceProof.case2Solution: We built a shared operations layer with live workforce visibility, coordinated workflows and verified service evidence.
experienceProof.case2Role: Estidam led operating model design and delivery governance, with Inspire supporting platform engineering and integration.
experienceProof.case3Title: Unified operations platform for multi-agency service delivery
experienceProof.case3Challenge: Service quality signals were scattered, making end-to-end assurance and escalation hard to manage at scale.
experienceProof.case3Solution: We delivered a unified assurance layer with shared KPIs, alerting flows and executive-ready operational dashboards.
experienceProof.case3Role: Estidam owned solution leadership and delivery management, while Inspire extended technical build and data pipelines.
